audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6] says you keep the two-item stage while win[6]/phases[6] give it to Sejuani.
audit.why: The mirror audit set the two-item stage to Sejuani in both layers and left stages 1 through first item with Urgot; the prose row was left behind.
audit.corrected: Two items is Sejuani's stage — her tank stats and CC outlast your spray; stages 1 through first item stay Urgot's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Late-game and two-item text is built on 'percent-health shred' from Purge and on a 25% execute number.
audit.why: Riot's Purge text says only that Urgot slows himself and unloads on nearby enemies, triggering Echoing Flames — no percent-max-health component. Fear Beyond Death's threshold is unnumbered in Riot's text. Both inherited claims drive build advice that inverts against a tank.
audit.corrected: Purge is flat physical damage, so Sejuani's armour and Frost Armor answer it as she itemizes; the execute is a threshold, not 25%.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to engage 'once Permafrost is down' — Permafrost has a 1.5s cooldown and is never meaningfully down.
audit.why: Riot kit: Permafrost is 1.5s at 560 range and only fires on a target at maximum Frost stacks. The gates are Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s), which applies the stacks, and Arctic Assault (18/16.5/15/13.5/12s), her only gap-closer. Frost Armor also grants slow immunity, so your Q and R slows do nothing while it holds.
audit.corrected: Deny the Frost stacks rather than the stun: after Winter's Wrath connects you are one hit from stunned, and her step-up is Arctic Assault on 18s at rank 1.

edits.before: With two items you keep it, percent-health shred melting even full-tank Sejuani.
edits.after: With two items Sejuani flips it, her tank stats and CC outlasting your spray.

edits.before: You keep the duel late: Urgot's percent-health W-shred melts even a full-tank Sejuani and R executes. She scales as a teamfight engage tank, not a sidelane threat.
edits.after: Late she catches up: Purge is flat physical damage, so her armour and Frost Armor blunt it, and Glacial Prison at 90s makes her a fight-starter you have to dodge.

edits.before: You keep the duel. Urgot's percent-health shred (W) melts even a full-tank Sejuani, and R executes; she scales as a peel and engage tank for teamfights, not a sidelane 1v1.
edits.after: Purge is flat physical, not percent-health, so her armour answers it once she is itemized. Keep R (100s at rank 1) for her step-up and duel her before Glacial Prison.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Permafrost is 1.5s — you cannot wait it out. The real gate is Winter's Wrath stacking Frost, and Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The E is 1.5s; deny the stacks instead — after her W lands twice you are one hit from stunned.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Sejuani is simply dead. Trade her to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death online — under its threshold Sejuani is dead through Frost Armor. Trade her to half, then the threat decides it.
